COMPLETED.verified: boolean - objective in-band verification flag for this low-level operation
COMPLETED.stateVersion: integer - authoritative version after the operation

cadState.activeDocumentPath: absolute path, or empty for an unsaved document

COMPLETED.result_geometry: optional object containing readback from the created/checked result

FAILED.stateVersion: integer - normally unchanged; rollback rebuild failure can report the advanced authoritative version
FAILED.cadState: optional current state using the COMPLETED cadState shape
FAILED.result_geometry: optional diagnostic readback, including standards-check violations

DUPLICATE.cadState: optional state from the original completed response
DUPLICATE.result_geometry: optional result from the original completed response
